prompt: Scan the repos in {{repos}} for private or sensitive content that must not appear in a public OSS push. Check for: hardcoded private IP addresses (e.g. 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, 100.x.x.x Tailscale ranges), internal reference identifiers, session reference numbers, the extra patterns in {{scrub_patterns}}. Exclude venv/ node_modules/ __pycache__ .git from grep. For each match, report: { repo: string, file: string, line: number, pattern: string, snippet: string }. Return: { leaks: [...], status: "clean" | "leaked" }
